mentions.name: pkgstore.io
mentions.description: A curated directory and marketplace for commercial .NET NuGet packages. Publishers can sell NuGet packages directly, with full dotnet push/restore support, Stripe payments, and automated access control. Currently in open beta and onboarding publishers.
mentions.problem: NuGet.org doesn't distinguish between a hobby project and a professionally maintained library with real support.
mentions.audience: Publishers of .NET NuGet packages looking to sell commercial libraries
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building pkgstore.io, a marketplace for commercial .NET NuGet packages.

https://www.pkgstore.io

NuGet.org doesn't distinguish between a hobby project and a professionally maintained library with real support. pkgstore is a curated directory and marketplace where publishers can sell NuGet packages directly, with full dotnet push/restore support, Stripe payments, and automated access control.
